name: Waterdrop C1H Countertop Instant Hot Reverse Osmosis System
description: Say goodbye to waiting for the kettle to boil! This premium Waterdrop C1H Countertop Reverse Osmosis (RO) Purifier is a complete game-changer for your daily hydration. Combining advanced 6-stage RO filtration with cutting-edge 3-second instant heating technology, it lets you dispense crystal-clear pure water at 5 adjustable temperatures (ambient up to 203°F) perfectly tailored for tea, coffee, oatmeal, or formula. Zero installation required—just plug it in anywhere from your kitchen counter to your office or RV. Features a smart LED screen for real-time TDS tracking, customized volume dispensing, and filter life updates. Note: The system functions flawlessly, but it is highly recommended that the buyer purchases a fresh new replacement filter (model WD-C1RF) online for optimal purification performance!
contact_note: The unit has been thoroughly drained, wiped down, and sanitized. Fully functional and dispenses piping hot water perfectly! Please plan to buy a brand new filter replacement (model WD-C1RF) online to enjoy the freshest taste.
meta_description: Pre-owned Waterdrop C1H instant hot water countertop reverse osmosis system in good condition. 3s heating, 5 temperature settings, smart LED touch screen.
name_zh: Waterdrop (水滴) C1H 台式即热反渗透智能净水直饮机
description_zh: 高端多功能直饮神机！Waterdrop C1H 净水机将高端6级反渗透（RO）深层过滤与“3秒即热”功能完美结合。完全免安装，插电即用。带有智能触控大屏，实时监测过滤前后TDS水质。支持五档水温调节（常温至203°F热水）以及多档定量出水。机器保养得非常好，加热及出水状态极其完美。注：为保证最佳的水质与出水口感，强烈建议买家入手后自行在线上购买并更换全新滤芯（对应滤芯型号为 WD-C1RF）。
